name: East Samsur Outpost
title: East Samsur Outpost
summary: The ruined starter outpost east of Samsur on a low sandy ridge: a 28 m Empyrean tower with green crown lights, two octagon towers, a Life Stone and a candle sentinel; the Destroyed Portal to Redspire crystal lies 117 m south-east, and 165 m west a pair of 8 m carved wooden masks with columns and Broken Seals of the Elder Spirits flank a gully path.

landmarks.name: Empyrean tower
landmarks.note: 0x01002866 with green ethereal lights at the crown (z 41.8).

landmarks.name: Octagon tower
landmarks.note: 0x01000F06; a second one 49 m south on the ridge.

landmarks.name: Giant wooden masks
landmarks.note: Two 0x020003B1 masks with ancient columns and Broken Seals of the Elder Spirits.

site.name: East Samsur Outpost
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer life-stone-near-samsur-9b7b (the outpost Life Stone).

shots.standingOrder: Climb counter-clockwise around the outpost's Empyrean tower from 34 m out and 8 m up to 44 m out and 30 m up, ending level with its glowing crown; stay 24 m off the tower walls.
shots.notes: Helix on the 28 m Empyrean tower of the ruined starter outpost, with green ethereal lights on its crown; the octagon tower, the Life Stone and the candle sentinel sit on the sandy ridge below; south-south-west sun (0.55) side-lights the tower as the camera climbs from looking up at it to level with its crown. shots.standingOrder: Arc 35 degrees counter-clockwise around the two giant wooden masks west of the outpost from 26 m out at 6.7 m height; keep 8 m from the stone columns and seals.
shots.notes: Curiosity beside the outpost: two 8 m carved wooden masks flank a gully path 165 m west of the Life Stone, framed by ancient stone columns and two Broken Seals of the Elder Spirits; the camera stays on the west side and arcs slowly so the masks change profile; sun from the south-south-west.
